_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/project.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: A project: the uploaded documents, ontology and graph behind a simulation, plus custom agents and saved papers. One project.json per project folder.
rules: Fields added after the first projects (custom agents, saved papers, enrichment) are optional because older projects never had them.

synthetic.note: True when the simulation requirement stood in for an uploaded document.
